q1.explanationZh: 第二段说车站里住着一群欧洲的科学家（scientists），第一段说它是地球上最冷（coldest）的地方之一。

evidence.quote: The station is home to a group of European

q2.explanationZh: 他们好几个月没吃到新鲜的水果（fruits）和蔬菜，所以填 fruits。

evidence.quote: having fresh fruits and vegetables the most.

q3.explanationZh: 文中说 Verseux 来自法国，Possnig 来自奥地利，所以先填 Austria，再填 France。

evidence.quote: Two of them are Cyprien Verseux from France, and Carmen Possnig from Austria

q4.sampleAnswer: Concordia Station in Antarctica is one of the coldest places on Earth.

keyPoints.descZh: 说出康宏站是地球上最冷的地方之一
examples: It is one of the coldest places on Earth.

keyPoints.descZh: 说出康宏站住着一群欧洲科学家
examples: It is home to a group of European scientists.

q4.rubricZh: 要点（答出其一即可）：最冷的地方之一；住着欧洲科学家。
q4.explanationZh: 文章第一句说康宏站是地球上最冷的地方之一，第二段说那里住着一群欧洲科学家，写出其中一点就可以。

evidence.quote: is one of the coldest places on Earth.

q5.sampleAnswer: They wanted to show what -80℃ to -70℃ felt like.

keyPoints.descZh: 想展示零下80到零下70摄氏度有多冷
examples: They wanted to show how cold it was.

q5.rubricZh: 要点：为了展示-80℃到-70℃的寒冷。
q5.explanationZh: 两位科学家把食物拿到外面，是想让大家看看零下七八十度有多冷，结果食物一下子都冻硬了。

evidence.quote: They wanted to show what -80℃ to -70℃ felt like

q6.sampleAnswer: They bury much of their food in the snow.

examples: They bury their food in the snow.

q6.explanationZh: 文章说科学家们把很多食物埋在雪里来保存，因为那里太冷，雪就像天然冰箱。

evidence.quote: They bury much of their food in the snow.

q7.explanationZh: Possnig 说“just living here is a reward”，住在这里本身就是一种回报，说明她很喜欢，所以回答 Yes。

evidence.quote: For me, just living here is a reward
